name: Monster Love
source:
"Monster Love" is a small visual novel about the player (you) spending the day with your best friend Wasabi in order to tell her how you feel. Do you have the courage to go through with it? 

[Taken from [url=https://maichu.itch.io/monster-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Monster Love》是一部小型视觉小说，讲述玩家（你）与你最好的朋友芥末度过一天，以便告诉她你的感受。你有勇气去面对它吗？

[摘自[url=https://maichu.itch.io/monster-love]itch.io[/url]]
